general: Extract every entity of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the query. Leave other text unlabelled.

classes.name: MedicalHealthIssue
classes.description: Any medical condition or health issue, to include everything from disease to broken bones to fever to general ill health, medical errors, even natural causes

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Corporations, agencies, and other groups of people defined by an established organizational structure.
rules: OR1 An ORG entity may be a single organization or a group.
OR2 A key feature of an ORG is that it can change members without changing identity.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: An information object such as a field of study or topic of communication, including thoughts, opinions, etc.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Geographical entities such as geographical areas and landmasses, bodies of water.

classes.name: Vehicle
classes.description: A physical device primarily designed to move an object from one location to another, by (for example) carrying, flying, pulling, or pushing the transported object.
rules: VE1 Vehicle entities may or may not have their own power source.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Person entities are limited to humans.
rules: PE1 A Person entity may be a single person or a group.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: A person's title or job role.

classes.name: Money
rules: MO1 The extent of a Money mention includes modifying quantifiers, the amount, and the currency unit, all of which can be optional.

classes.name: BodyPart
classes.description: An identifiable, living part of a human's or animal's body, such as a eye, ear, neck, leg, etc.

classes.name: CommercialProduct
classes.description: A tangible product or article of trade for which someone pays or barters, or more generally, an artifact or a thing.

classes.name: Numeric
classes.description: A numerical value or non-numerical value such as an informational property such as color or make or URL.

classes.name: Weapon
classes.description: A physical device that is primarily used as an instrument for physically harming or destroying entities.

classes.name: GPE
classes.description: Geopolitical entities such as countries, provinces, states, cities, towns, etc. GPEs are composite entities, consisting of a physical location, a government, and a population.
rules: GP1 All three of these elements must be present for an entity to be tagged as a GPE.
GP2 A GPE entity may be a single geopolitical entity or a group.

classes.name: SideOfConflict
classes.description: The different sides of a conflict, such as philosophical, cultural, ideological, religious, political, guiding philosophical movement or group orientation.
rules: SO1 This will encompass sides of the battle/conflict, sports fans when salient, and other such affiliations, in addition to religions, political parties, and other philosophies.

classes.name: Abstract
classes.description: Abstract, non-tangible artifacts such as software (e.g., programs, tool kits, apps, e-mail), measureable intellectual property, contracts, etc. (nb: does not include laws, which are LAW type)

classes.name: Facility
rules: FA1 Facilities are artifacts falling under the domains of architecture and civil engineering, including more temporary human constructs, such as police lines and checkpoints.
